 Oral Order  07 / Dated : 18.08.2023  Heard learned counsel for the parties.

The petitioner named above has been made accused in connection with Doranda (Argora) P.S. Case No. 259 of 2012 (G.R. No. 3104 of 2012) for the offence under Sections 420, 406 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the court of J.M.F.C., Ranchi.

entities.text: Doranda (Argora) P.S. Case No. 259 of 2012 (G.R. No. 3104 of 2012)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that Section 406 of IPC is punishable with three years of imprisonment and Section 420 is up to seven years.
As per the FIR, the petitioner had assured the informant of getting him government job in the railway.
The entire amount was not been taken by the petitioner rather part of the amount has been received by Rajiv Chandra.
It is also submitted that the informant was also complicit in procuring government employment by illegal means.
Said Rajiv Chandra has already been granted bail.

Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted the petitioner is named in the FIR and there is direct allegation against the petitioner defrauding the informant and others for providing them employment in the railway.
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two Babul Kumar @ Bablu Kumar Singh @ Prithwi ... vs The State Of Jharkhand ... .... 1 sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Court below.
